correctness.rationale: For every 1<p<infty and every complex upper-triangular 2x2 matrix, derive the circle formula from the unique ell_p norming functional and its filled-disk version by intermediate value. Strict concavity f''<0 gives unique interior support t(c), real analyticity, and support curvature radius Bf(t)+L^2 sin^2(theta)/(-Bf''(t))>0 whenever B>0. Exact implicit third differentiation gives G'''(0)=2 alpha beta (beta-alpha)/(B^2 F^2), nonzero iff p!=2; reflection symmetry of the body forces the odd support function to be linear, contradiction. Hausdorff symmetry defect equals uniform distance of G(Lx)-G(-Lx) to the linear span of x; Taylor remainder O_p(L^5/B^4) and the exact minimax distance dist(x^3, span{x})=1/4 prove the sharp cubic coefficient. The 25,215 deterministic numerical diagnostics are supplementary, not substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: The result answers a natural finite-dimensional Banach numerical-range shape problem at a sharp Hilbert/non-Hilbert boundary and gives a structural, everywhere-positive curvature law. The new sharp reflection-defect asymptotic distinguishes genuine geometric asymmetry from the prior established convexity, with exact cubic onset, universal Chebyshev coefficient and explicit quartic case. It quantifies precisely the deformation of the classical elliptic range under a small spectral diagonal splitting, a motivated invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
